= Overview =

A group of usually [[Race|racial]] but sometimes ideological allies.

Two main factions in [[World of Warcraft]] are the [[Alliance]] and the [[Horde]]. Players of one of these factions are always at war with the other. Other independent [[Neutral]] factions also exist.

Also see [[:Category:Faction]].
